items.title: Edward "Kid" Ory Interview, 1957-04-20
items.q: So Joe Alva and Jimmy Noon was with me then.

ctx.x: He was making too much money, Louie?

All the $50 of a week in Chicago, and $300, $400 a night off my dance with you. And working on wrestling. I said, why? You go out of business, go wait for someone for now. Maybe in Chicago. So Joe Alva and Jimmy Noon was with me then. He said, we'd like to go to Chicago. I said, you want a job? I said, here's a telegram. He's right. So they went? They took the job. They didn't have raise enough to get coffee from the man, Joe and Jimmy. I said, did you guys get any of your transportation to get some advance…

items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta and Edward "Kid" Ory Interview, 1958-08-26
items.q: Yeah. He was playing with me at the time, Joe.

ctx.x: Yeah. He was playing with me at the time, Joe. I got a telegram. And right after it was ready, Joe made up his mind to leave. And I had a telegram. I didn't want to go. So I turned the job over to Joe. And he's taking Jimmy with him.

Now, I'm going to proceed on with you now. Me and him was buddies. You know. We'd go out on Mondays, you know, and of course, Kid Ore. He's a drawing card. He said Kid Ore is everything because we had all the work. I got on my office and I'm going to leave this town. I got to go to California. I got to go. Remember when I came over and talked to my mom? Yes. I got to come over to my house on a Monday and talk to my mother. Come over there about ten o'clock in the morning. Monday morning and talk. You know, you…
